svg.aria-label: MIDI Control for Fireface: the Setup sheet

g.text: MIDIMATE eX Port 1 ⇄ MIDIMATE eX Port 1
Click the lane or a strip to read any 8
strips — the app plans BANK and
Out 1/2 on the output faders — this level
and those two strips are one fader. Dim
and Mute are faked there; moving it
Out 9/10 — the same mechanism on another
pair. No click at either end: the
hardware ramps, the app never does.
The same three switches sit on strip 1 as
D · L · speaker. Write-only toggles: the
unit never reports them, so this is what
the app believes. The Limiter lamp shows
The unit sends no level data stand-alone.
Everything here is what the app commanded
or read back — never what it heard.
changed since the snapshot — not saved yet
the level Dim and Mute come back to
linked in the app — two writes, never the unit's gang
What this unit powers on with, and the reference levels and clock the app puts on it at every
connect. They are the device’s alone: no snapshot switches the reference levels or the clock.
+48 V and the instrument options at power-on
What the flash brings up, as set in TotalMix; the unit never reports it. After a power cycle the
app takes the unit to be in this state, then switches back whatever you pressed in the mixer. As
booted holds this same state and follows every change here.
Out 28 sits in no window, so nothing over MIDI reaches its fader and the unit never reports it:
the level is the flash’s alone. The app never sends this — it only shows it on the Out 28 card.
The production flash leaves it at 0.0 dB; what it plays is submix 27/28, mixed like any other.
A position chosen here is pressed at every connect where the unit has not reported holding it, so
a change made over MIDI, which the unit drops at the next power cycle, is put back.
Switching between AutoSync and Master drops every device clocked from the Fireface until it
nobody chose — as it powers on
Mic 7 on — pressed in the mixer
nobody pressed — as it powers on
Nothing. The power-on state is stated, so a connect
switches +48 V either way to put back what you pressed.
The setup switches are radio positions with no query:
pressing the one the unit holds reads it back for free,
pressing another changes it. The one free reading is the
block on the first dump after a power cycle.
Saved as you change it. The device’s ⋯ menu and Device ▸ Setup… open this sheet.
